name: Mitten Extracts | 3g Max Pro Disposable | Super Lemon Haze
description:
This sativa-dominant hybrid of Lemon Skunk and Super Silver Haze may be found covered in kief and coloring. With it’s lemon characteristics the consumer will be left with a zesty lemon, sweet and citrus aftertaste.

Packed with 3G of Liquid Diamonds + Live Resin terpenes for a smooth, powerful experience that lasts. Fine-tune every hit with Flavor, Balance, or Clouds mode.
